svg.text: AWS us-east-1 · default VPC · 2 EC2 servers · EKS Auto Mode · public NLBs
What was actually deployed in this project
Ports, security groups and traffic paths
Default VPC 172.31.0.0/16 · default public subnets in several AZs · Internet Gateway
1 You open Jenkins :8080, SonarQube :9000, Docker app :8081
3 Users open the Kubernetes app via the NLB on :80
4 You open the Argo CD UI via its NLB on :443
5-6 Prometheus scrapes metrics over private IPs
7 Jenkins server runs kubectl/helm against EKS
8 CI talks to GitHub, Docker Hub and Gmail
9 Argo CD pulls manifests, nodes pull the image
